newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian stocks seen firmer as U.S. surges.
newsitem.headline: Australian stocks seen firmer as U.S. surges.

text.p: *Stocks seen stronger after U.S. markets surge, rate cut
digested. "I'm hoping for 10 to 15 points out of it. We've got
good support and most people are confident," said one broker.
*Wall Street stocks surged to topple a broad array of records as interest rates fell to 1-1/2 year lows.
*ADRs: News Corp 18-1/2 (-1/4), BHP 27-1/8 (-1/8), WMC 23-9/16 (+6/16), National Australia Bank 73-5/16 -3/16)
*Gold price was firmer. On LME, a swift downturn in zinc pulled other metals from their highs by the close. Copper, aluminium and nickel all lost some ground.
